turns.q: How do I use it properly the very first time?
turns.replyTail:
y first time?
For your first use:



Put the warmer in a safe spot and plug it into an outlet.


Add 1–2 wax bears to the dish.


Turn it on or set the timer if your warmer has one.


Let it melt and enjoy the scent.



Just a couple of quick tips: keep the cord away from hot surfaces, and make sure it doesn’t hang over an edge.
When you’re ready to change scents, the silicone dish makes it easy to pop out the used wax cleanly.
If you have any other questions or need more tips, feel free to ask!
